justification: Pre-checked $39.99 protection plan marked 'Included in your order' but Total shown excludes it; 'Only 2 left — sale ends tonight' urgency; auto-renewing membership ($9.99/mo) buried in 7px fine print.

Fabricated social-proof notifications ('Someone liked your post', 'A user is viewing your profile') all admit 'No identity reference — tap view anyway'; view counter 'growing every minute' implies fake live activity to bait taps.
Standard account creation with clearly labeled ToS checkbox and disabled button until checked; partner-policies clause is vague but not hidden; no manipulative structure.

Checkout pricing is honest ($89 + free shipping = $89). Oddly, 'Proceed to payment' button disappears after click in later state with nothing replacing it, but no manipulative/deceptive pattern present.
Honest membership cancellation flow: 'Cancel my membership' is the prominent primary button, 'Keep my membership' is secondary; no retention tricks.
Free trial silently converts to $14.99/mo charged to cached Visa token once trial concludes; no consent or opt-out step shown at transition.
Settings presented as flat list with all entries at same 0px indentation; nothing buried or visually degraded.
Honest cart offering guest checkout as primary option and account creation as secondary; no forced account.
Free-trial signup with clear upfront disclosure of $5.00 monthly fee after trial, auto-renewal, and cancel-anytime statement.
Fake scarcity: pulsing 'Only 2 left at this price!' badge, and later states explicitly state stock never depletes and is stuck at a fabricated low threshold.
Cookie banner offers only 'Accept all' and 'Not now' — no reject/opt-out of non-essential cookies; 'By continuing you agree' pushes default acceptance.
News feed where the ad card is clearly labeled 'AD' and 'Sponsored'; editorial cards are genuine; disclosure present.
Paged reader shows progress badge '1/3' so total length is disclosed; 'Keep reading... always one more page' is a nudge but not deceptive given visible pagination.
Consent banner in English but the opt-out control is rendered in French ('Refuser les cookies non essentiels') for an en-US user — obscures the decline option.
Location consent auto-registers consent after a 5s countdown unless user acts; agree checkbox disabled and default direction is consent to share with 14 ad partners.
Address-book harvesting: huge bold 'Invite all 128 contacts' primary button vs tiny dotted 'skip' link; strong nudge to share all contacts.
Fair cookie banner: Accept All and Reject All are equal, one-click, symmetric choices; text explicitly promises equal ease of access.
Settings with search and 'Exit found' badge; delete-account, data export, and marketing controls all directly reachable in the DOM.
Flash-sale countdown ticks down across states (0:11, 0:10) consistent with a real deadline; no evidence in captured states of a resetting or fabricated timer.

Multiple ontology patterns: Bad Defaults/Preselection (protection-plan checkbox pre-checked at t0 with financial-cost intent, no user event); Drip Pricing (Total $299.00 omits the checked +$39.99 add-on it says is 'Included'); Hidden Information (auto-renewing $9.99/mo membership in 7px/40%-opacity fine print); FOMO/Low Stock urgency banner ('Only 2 left — sale ends tonight').

Activity Messages #3: notifications ('Someone liked your post', 'A user is viewing your profile', 'Several people viewed your listing') contain no IdentityRef — DOM explicitly states 'No identity reference — tap view anyway' (Specificity < tau, no verifiable identity); High Demand: '214 profile views · growing every minute' is an unbounded, unfalsifiable metric.

Checked against Automatic Accept Third Party Term: consent is NOT pre-checked and requires affirmative user toggle (button disabled until checked), so trigger 3 (Checked=True ∧ UserToggled=False) fails; 'policies of our partners' is vague (mild opaque-entity concern) but no structural deception. Benign account creation.

Drip Pricing check: P(s_n)=$89.00 = P(s_0), no hidden fees, shipping $0 disclosed; no fee terminology concealed. Anomaly: 'Proceed to payment' node removed in s1 leaving empty div — but no ontology pattern (Dead End requires forced compliance edges; here flow simply ends) — no deceptive trigger.

False Hierarchy check: the user-favorable 'Cancel my membership' is the primary <button> (accent, full width) while business-favorable 'Keep my membership' is demoted to a muted secondary style — the inverse of the pattern's required asymmetry; Confirmshaming: no negative sentiment on the decline option. Benign, honest exit flow.

Forced Continuity #1: t>=t_expiry triggers silent S_trial->S_premium state mutation AND E_charge against cached payment token (Visa •••• 4242, $14.99/mo) with Consent_explicit=False — s0 '7 days remaining' -> s1 'trial concluded' + 'premium' badge shows the charge executing with no confirmation step; #2: no renewal warning within fair-notice window.

Customisation/Interface Nesting #2 and Labyrinthine Navigation #2 checks: all settings entries rendered at 0px indentation (DOM: 'max render = 0px'), no nesting or visual burial of privacy controls; Data & cookies entry is highlighted, not hidden. No trigger.

Forced Registration checks: guest checkout exists (S_auth not on every path), and 'Checkout as guest' is the primary filled button while 'Create account' is secondary — guest path is NOT visually degraded (no visual-weight asymmetry against user). Benign.

Forced Continuity #2 (Absence of Temporal Feedforward): fee disclosure IS present and visually highlighted ('$5.00 monthly service fee applies after your 7-day free trial... cancel at any time' in emphasized box, <strong> markup) — no concealment; Hidden Information checks fail (critical terms visible and emphasized). Benign trial signup.

Low Stock #1 Inventory Fabrication: badge 'Only 2 left at this price!' (I_displayed <= tau_scarcity) with later states explicitly stating stock 'never actually depletes — stuck at a fabricated low threshold' (I_displayed << I_true); FOMO #2: badge uses animate-pulse (sub-second visual pulsation) to manufacture urgency.

Privacy Maze #1: d(v_start, v_reject_all) is undefined — no reject/decline path exists at all; only 'Accept all' (button) and 'Not now' (defer, no rejection) are offered, so rejection effort exceeds acceptance (d -> inf); banner text 'By continuing you agree to this processing' converts passive continuation into consent. No reject vector in DOM.

Disguised Ad checks: ad card carries explicit 'AD' and 'Sponsored' labels (no Cross-Origin Action Masking; labels break morphological/semantic masquerade); state note confirms editorial card is 'genuine editorial content on the host domain'. Native-ads pattern not triggered due to disclosure.

Addictive Design #2 / Infinite Scrolling #3 checks: stopping cues ARE present — pagination badge '1/3' and ‹ › navigation controls rendered (boundary marker exists), so no eradication of completion cues; 'Keep reading... always one more page' is a mild nudge but total length is disclosed.

Wrong Language #2 (Visual-Linguistic Locale Mismatch): critical functional node (privacy opt-out 'Refuser les cookies non essentiels') rendered in French while browser locale is en-US (L_DOM(N_critical) != L_browser), explicitly labeled 'Cookie controls: Français'; #3: Lang(N_critical) != L_session with high confidence — opt-out intentionally obscured by language barrier.

Automating The User Away #1: consent executed autonomously at t>=tau ('Consent will be registered in 5 seconds unless you decide') with E_user=emptyset — consent to share location with 14 ad partners auto-registered on timeout; Bad Defaults: default state = consent (privacy-loss domain), and the 'I agree' checkbox is disabled so the default cannot be pre-empted.

Address Book Leeching #2: A(N_invite_all)/A(N_skip) >> dominance ratio — 'Invite all 128 contacts' is a huge bold shadowed button (py-4) vs 8px dotted-underline 'skip' link; #3: benefactive framing 'to make SnapGrid better for everyone' reframes contact extraction as social benefit; Friend Spam #2: no granular per-contact selection (single invite-all action).

Privacy Maze checks all fail: d(v_start, v_reject_all)=1 = d(v_start, v_accept_all) (DOM states the distance explicitly), visual prominence symmetric (grid-cols-2 equal-weight buttons), no obfuscation — Accept All and Reject All are structurally and visually equal. Benign consent UI.

Immortal Accounts checks: deletion vector present and prominent (K_del ∩ T_DOM ≠ ∅; 'Delete account' highlighted with 'deletion steps ∩ DOM' badge — not visually demoted); download-data and marketing-preference controls at same level; no path-depth asymmetry (N(x_delete) low, all steps in DOM). Benign settings.

Countdown Timer #1 (Stateless Expiration) check: captured states show monotonic decrement 0:11 -> 0:10 -> 0:10 — no reset on re-render (T(s0)!=T(s1) for a resetting timer), so fabricated-urgency trigger NOT confirmed; 'while the deadline lasts' is vague (Limited Time Message #3 borderline) but no structural evidence of synthetic deadline in the states. Benign flash-sale timer.
